svg.text: RULE: EACH DIGIT THE SUM OF THE DIGITS 1, 3 AND 5 PLACES EARLIER, MOD 10; PRIMER 1 2 3 4 5
Digit 6 is 5 + 3 + 1 = 9 (places 5, 3 and 1). Place 26 carries 6, place 27 carries 1.
Form M[P + d] = c: N (13) + 6 = slot 19; O (14) + 1 = slot 15. Both must hold the carved Q.
Two different slots of one alphabet cannot both hold Q: this primer is dead.
